_comment: Gloss (tn=) corrections accepted from the adversarial example-sentence review of 2026-07-25, applied to Konjugieren/Models/Verbs.xml by apply_gloss_corrections.py. Each entry records the shipped gloss, the replacement, and why. Applied without human triage at Josh's instruction; this file is the record that makes any individual call reviewable and reversible. 'cand' means the correct sense was already sitting in verbdata/candidates.json and the kaikki import promoted the wrong one, which makes the finding a mechanical defect rather than a judgment call.

abrollen.why: cand: sentence unwinds wire from a spool; 'roll off' is the vehicle sense

abschmecken.old: taste a dish and, if necessary
abschmecken.why: import truncated the definition mid-clause at the second comma

absenden.why: 'forward, send on' is weiterleiten; absenden carries no passing-along component

abtöten.why: cand: 'mortify' is the rare ascetic sense taken by entry order

anhauen.why: cand: sentence is the colloquial ask-for-money sense, not a physical strike

anheimfallen.why: cand: sentence is neutral legal escheat; 'fall victim' adds absent negative framing

anreisen.why: cand: anreisen is always travel to a destination, never plain 'take a trip'

anscheinen.why: cand: 'appear, seem' is archaic impersonal, surviving only in the adverb anscheinend

ansinnen.why: judgment call, no candidates: 'designate' bears no relation; cf. the noun Ansinnen

antanzen.why: cand: nobody in the sentence is dancing; sense 2 is the everyday reading

aufrechnen.why: cand: gegen + accusative is diagnostic of the legal set-off sense

ausfolgen.why: cand: Austrian administrative German for aushändigen; import mis-split by analogy to folgen

auslagern.why: cand: 'swap' is the IT memory sense; sentence outsources accounting

ausrauchen.why: cand: sentence is transitive finish-smoking, not driving something out by smoke

ausschweigen.why: judgment call, no candidates: verb is obligatorily reflexive and takes a topic (über etwas)

beehren.why: cand: 'compliment' is ein Kompliment machen; sentence is the canonical mit seiner Anwesenheit

bescheißen.old: shit on, sully with feces, beshit
bescheißen.why: cand: literal scatological sense taken first; the swindle sense is the living one

durchspielen.why: unbalanced trailing parenthesis, an import artifact from a nested dictionary gloss

einflechten.why: gloss defect, not a wrong pick: 'weave together' is verflechten; einflechten adds into an existing braid

einkriegen.why: cand: sentence is reflexive sich vor Lachen nicht mehr einkriegen

einrollen.why: cand: sentence furls posters; 'roll in' is the intransitive train sense

entgegensehen.why: cand: 'look at' is a literal calque of entgegen + sehen and is not a live meaning

entmieten.why: only the dictionary's parenthetical usage label survived the import

fernschauen.why: cand: Austrian and southern German for watching TV; first-listed sense taken

freihaben.why: sentence has a single Friday off, not a vacation; 'be on vacation' is Urlaub haben

gehaben.why: cand: sentence is the farewell Gehabt euch wohl!, the sich wohl gehaben sense

gleichschalten.new: bring into line, force into conformity
gleichschalten.why: cand: 'synchronise' is the marginal electrical sense and hides the Nazi-era political freight a learner must see

heranbrechen.why: cand: sentence is a period of time setting in (Als der Morgen heranbrach)

hereinlegen.why: cand: sentence is figurative jemanden hereinlegen

herumspinnen.why: cand: the literal rotational reading is essentially unattested for this verb

hinwegschauen.new: overlook, turn a blind eye to
hinwegschauen.why: shipped gloss was a dictionary cross-reference, not a usable meaning

kaltmachen.why: 'duppy' is Jamaican English and opaque to learners; unfiltered synonym-list import

nachbacken.why: cand: 'recook' wrongly suggests reheating and is odd English for a baking verb

nachsteigen.why: cand: sentence is the colloquial romantic-pursuit sense, not the climbing sense

niederführen.why: 'run someone over' belongs to the near-homograph niederfahren

niederhauen.why: cand: a robbery is not a contest; sentence strikes a single guard down

totsagen.why: cand: sentence is a vinyl record, the report-something's-end sense

umlagern.why: gloss belongs to the separable homograph úmlagern; entry is the inseparable umlágern

umschulen.why: cand: sentence is vocational retraining, not transferring a pupil

umtreten.why: 'boot' reads as starting a computer and loses the um- over-so-it-falls component

untermalen.why: cand: 'underpaint' is the literal painting technique; sentence scores a scene with music

verbeißen.why: cand: sentence is reflexive sich das Lachen verbeißen

verkochen.why: 'forwall' is an obsolete English verb a learner cannot parse

versteuern.old: tax, put a tax on something
versteuern.why: cand: levying is besteuern; versteuern is the taxpayer paying

vorbauen.why: cand: sentence is the proverbial wer klug ist, baut vor; preassembling is vorfertigen

vorbeischauen.why: cand: first-listed literal sense taken over the dominant one

widersagen.why: cand: sentence is the liturgical dem Bösen widersagen; objecting is widersprechen

zurückversetzen.new: transport back to an earlier time
zurückversetzen.why: cand: sentence is the metaphorical evoked-association sense

zusammenkehren.why: cand: 'pile up' loses the kehren (sweep) that is the core of the verb

zusammenräumen.why: cand: sentence tidies a living room rather than gathering belongings to leave

zuschwellen.why: 'swell up' blurs the zu- shut component and collides with anschwellen

übereinanderhalten.new: hold on top of each other
übereinanderhalten.why: cand: nothing in the sentence is clenched or held shut

überfordern.why: cand: nothing in the sentence involves a price

überhelfen.why: 'force on someone' implies coercion; verb is helping someone into a garment
